name: browser-use
headline: AI Rules Sync: Manage and Share AI Assets
short_description: Synchronize, manage, and share your ai agents, rules, skills, commands (Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, OpenCode, Trae AI) with ease.
author: lbb00

sections.overview:
AI Rules Sync (AIS) is a command-line tool that manages AI agent configurations across multiple tools and projects from a centralized Git repository. It eliminates manual copying of rule files by creating symbolic links that automatically sync updates everywhere. The tool supports Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, OpenCode, Trae, Cline, Windsurf, Codex, Gemini CLI, Warp, and universal AGENTS.md format. Teams can share coding standards and AI instructions via Git, streamlining onboarding and keeping sensitive rules local with privacy-first configuration options. Perfect for organizations standardizing AI agent behavior across development teams.
Share AI coding standards and rules across team projects via Git
Onboard new team members with consistent AI agent instructions via 'ais install'
Maintain a single source of truth for AI rules across multiple tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code)
Keep sensitive local rules private while sharing company standards
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/lbb00/ai-rules-sync`
sections.usage:
```
Create a synchronization plan for my AI agents, rules, and skills across [PLATFORM_1], [PLATFORM_2], and [PLATFORM_3]. Ensure compatibility with [SPECIFIC_FEATURE_1] and [SPECIFIC_FEATURE_2]. Provide a step-by-step guide for seamless integration and conflict resolution.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
